headline: Every house on the beach lane came back live again this morning — all ten on Dauphin Island and all three in Gulf Shores are still active at exactly the prices carried here, with not one move in the last fourteen hours, and nothing new under the cap qualified. The commercial lanes stay frozen at their July 29 snapshot until Friday morning, when they get their first retry in a week.

That combination does not last, and it is the profile to move fast on when the next one appears.
